title: A unit minor and vanishing larger minors give an inner inverse
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, let n,p,d be natural numbers, and let P be an n-by-p matrix over R. Let rows:Fin d↪Fin n and cols:Fin d↪Fin p be embeddings. Assume det(P.submatrix rows cols) is a unit and det(P.submatrix rows' cols')=0 for every pair of embeddings rows':Fin(d+1)↪Fin n and cols':Fin(d+1)↪Fin p. Then there exists a p-by-n matrix Q over R such that PQP=P, using matrix multiplication. No positivity or nontriviality assumptions are required.
lean_statement: ∀ {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (n p d : ℕ) (P : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin p) R) (rows : Fin d ↪ Fin n) (cols : Fin d ↪ Fin p) (_hunit : IsUnit (Matrix.det (P.submatrix rows cols))) (_hnext : ∀ (rows' : Fin (d + 1) ↪ Fin n) (cols' : Fin (d + 1) ↪ Fin p), Matrix.det (P.submatrix rows' cols') = 0), ∃ Q : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin n) R, P * Q * P = P
